_allowedIpRanges_note: Optional CloudFront IP allowlist (IPv4 and/or IPv6 CIDRs). When set, everything NOT in this list is blocked at the edge via WAF. Setting this forces WAF on, overriding enableWaf: false. Leave as an empty array [] or remove the key to disable.
_smusDomainId_note: Optional SMUS (SageMaker Unified Studio) integration. Set to your DataZone domain id (dzd_xxxx, from the SMUS/DataZone console) to enable dataset catalog-link indicators, the 'View in SMUS' action, and SMUS filtering. Leave empty or remove the key to hide all SMUS UI.
_smusPortalUrl_note: Optional override for the SMUS portal URL, only needed for custom SMUS domains. When empty it is derived as https://{smusDomainId}.sagemaker.{region}.on.aws.
